map.次月利息=次月剩余本金×月利率。次月剩余本金=首月本金−首月偿还的本金部分，因此: Next month interest = next month remaining principal × monthly rate. The next month remaining principal = first month principal − the principal repaid in the first month, so the next month interest is slightly lower than the first month, and the difference equals the first month principal repayment × the monthly rate.

map.等额本息每月月供固定，但利息按「剩余本金×月利率」计。还款初期剩余本金最高，利息: In an equal installment loan the monthly payment is fixed, but interest is charged on "remaining principal × monthly rate". Early in the term the remaining principal is highest, so interest takes the largest share; as the principal is gradually amortised, the interest share falls month by month and the principal share rises.

map.首月利息=贷款总额×月利率，月利率=年利率÷12。等额本息首期剩余本金即全额，故: First month interest = total loan × monthly rate, and monthly rate = annual rate ÷ 12. In an equal installment loan the remaining principal in the first period is the full amount, so the first month interest is the highest and then declines month by month as the principal is amortised.
